name: Why hire a remodeling contractor for painting instead of a standalone paint company?

mainEntity.name: Why hire a remodeling contractor for painting instead of a standalone paint company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a full-scope remodeling contractor ensures that surface preparation and painting are tightly coordinated with other trades. Drywall repairs, custom trim installation, and wall texturing can be adjusted immediately by the same crew rather than waiting for a separate sub-trade to return. Having an on-site lead overseeing carpentry, drywall, and finish coatings prevents schedule delays, reduces conflicting trade handoffs, and ensures trim work and wall surfaces align smoothly before the final coats cure.
acceptedAnswer.description: A remodeling contractor handles drywall repairs, carpentry adjustments, and finish painting together under one lead, avoiding trade handoff delays.
